name: Twist the Knife (Combat)
body:
You can apply speed and strength along with precision to deal grievous harm with smaller weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Finesse, powerful sneak rogue talent, sneak attack +3d6.

Benefit(s): When you hit an opponent that is flanked or denied its Dexterity bonus with a light weapon, as a swift action you can twist the weapon in the wound, applying both your Strength and Dexterity modifier as a bonus to your damage roll.
